input.prompt: Concept art of a suit of futuristic powered armor standing upright on an invisible mannequin, strict front view, full body from the neck down with NO head and NO helmet, empty neck opening at the top. Arms hang straight down close against the sides of the body, legs straight and close together, symmetrical neutral pose. Sleek layered armor plates with subtle classical Roman cuirass influence on the chest, over a dark charcoal servo bodysuit visible at the joints, waist and inner arms. A compact shield generator rides the upper back, showing as a low ridge behind the shoulders. Every armor plate is plain matte white with no paint, trim, emblems or markings; the undersuit is dark charcoal grey. Bold, chunky, readable shapes with few small details. Plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no logo.
